questions.prompt: An 8,000 Hz recording contains 16,000 samples. How long is it?
questions.explanation: Duration is sample count divided by sample rate: 16,000 / 8,000 = 2.

questions.prompt: A spectrogram has one bright vertical stripe across many frequencies. What does it suggest?
questions.explanation: Time runs across the plot. Energy spanning frequencies at one time indicates a short broadband event.

questions.prompt: Your model performs well on simulated telephone audio. What should you test next?
questions.explanation: A channel simulation covers selected distortions. Real calls add different noise, devices and network conditions.
